parameters.description: large rough boulder of pale grey building stone with flat cleaved faces and a few chisel marks, no ore, black outline, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors

hit.animationDescription: the stone boulder shudders slightly from a pick blow and settles still, the stone staying in place, no particles, no effects

down.animationDescription: the stone boulder slowly crumbles and settles down into a low flat scatter of broken pale grey stone chips on the ground, the stone keeping its colour, no flash, no particles, no effects

endFrame.editDescription: the boulder has been quarried away: only a low flat scatter of broken pale grey stone chips and a few small cut blocks remains on the ground; empty transparent space above it

rejected.name: slabs
rejected.description: low outcrop of pale grey layered stone slabs jutting from the ground, squared edges, no ore, black outline, warm earthy tones, NES-era retro pixel art, few colors
rejected.why: Read as stone already cut, on a sand patch of its own that sits oddly on the battle's ground.

chosenBy: The owner, 2026-11-26 (Issue-356), from the two looks at 4× on the battle's green beside the kept ore vein and its rubble, taking the agent's recommendation: the boulder, unlike the dark vein at a glance.
verified: Every PNG here is byte-identical to the same file in PixelLab's own export of the object, downloaded 2026-11-26.
